rules.statement: The petitioner is entitled to a certificate under Rule 26 of the rules in the schedule to The Appeals (Privy Council) Ordinance that he is the proper person to be substituted or entered on the record in place of the deceased plaintiff.
rules.supporting_quote: "I do not think, however, that it is possible to take a similar view in regard to D. C. Colombo Case No. 2882. The averments and the prayer in the plaint in that case (the issues on which the trial proceeded are not before me) make it clear that the action was one in which the plaintiff, as trustee, sought to vindicate his legal title to the premises in suit. If the averments are true the trustee was bound under potion 13 of the Trusts Ordinance (Cap. 72) to maintain the action."

meta.parties: Morontuduwe Sri Gnaneswara Dhammananda Nayake Thera v. Baddegama Piyaratna Nayake Thera
